items.exampleEn: I don't like coffee, and she doesn't either.
items.exampleZh: 我不喜歡咖啡，她也不喜歡。

items.audioEn: Is anyone free tonight? I want to see a movie.
items.audioZh: 今晚有人有空嗎？我想去看電影。

items.sentenceEn: Everyone, please come along with me.
I can't swim, and my brother can't either.
items.sentenceZh: 我不會游泳，我弟弟也不會。

items.stemEn: ____ book is this? Is it yours?

items.passageEn: Our school is near a small river. Every Friday, everyone walks by the river after class. Today, it is ten past three, and the teacher asks, "Is everyone here?" Ken is late again. He doesn't like walking, and his friend Ben doesn't either.
items.passageZh: 我們學校在一條小河附近。每個星期五放學後，大家都會在河邊散步。今天三點十分，老師問：「大家都到了嗎？」Ken 又遲到了。他不喜歡散步，他的朋友 Ben 也不喜歡。

rubricZh: 問所有人用 Whose＋名詞（例如 Whose coat is this?）
寫 Who does this coat belong to? 也正確

items.instructionZh: 用 near 造一個句子，說說你家附近有什麼。
referenceEn: There is a park near my home.
I live near a big supermarket.
rubricZh: near 後面通常直接接地點（例如 near my home）
可用 There is… near…、I live near… 等
